text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
At Rice Shower's request, we keep<n>training up until
the very last minute of<n>summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hurry up, Rice! The bus is waiting for<n>you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Thank goodness I made it.
choice_data_list: We're lucky that everyone waited for you.
We're lucky that everyone waited for you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Right! I'll have to thank them...

Sorry, everyone! It looks like the road<n>ahead closed
only a minute ago.

text_block_list.name: Bus Driver
text_block_list.text:
It may take us an additional two<n>hours to return to
campus.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry! It's all my fault!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower is almost inconsolable<n>for the rest of
the trip. She even goes<n>to apologize to everyone on
the bus<n>personally.
